description: Taverity lets users work with an assistant to find contact lists, preview personal follow-up texts, and queue approved one-time messages in their Taverity account. Queued messages surface in the Taverity iPhone app and are sent from the user's own iPhone number after approval; the MCP server does not send SMS directly.
